title: Jesse Minter: "Unacceptable" that we haven't been able to run the ball consistently

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jesse Minter: "Unacceptable" that we haven't been able to run the ball consistently
sources.description: The Ravens have lost five straight games since a 4-1 start to the season and a look at the team's results running the ball during the two halves of their season presents a big reason why their fortunes have changed.
